text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Marvelous Sunday is taking dance lessons,
so I peek in to see how she's doing—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Five, six, seven, eight!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's gotten much closer to the steps in the video, but...
it looks like stepping in a bit harder would work better.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Focus on the step-in, right? Thanks a bunch! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it's Trainer!
Did you come to watch? Marve-lo-us☆
choice_data_list: Yeah. You two are taking lessons together, huh?
Yeah. You two have been taking lessons together, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because Air Groove is amazing!
She watches over things so strictly☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I feel like I'm
just one step away from mastering Mom's dance!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ah! Mom's dance is—this one! Footage from her recent Canada tour☆ I wanna learn this choreography★☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The craze must be tremendous.
And the choreography as well—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's right! It's super difficult, but she makes it look totally effortless☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Because Mama is a world-renowned dancer! She's in high demand as a dance teacher, too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"So she wasn't home very often, but...
She always sends me videos like this
from wherever she's performing!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Through the stage,
she brought so many smiles to me☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to dance just like Mama!
I copied her a bunch and practiced so hard! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Win the race and deliver marvelousness ☆
And make it even more marvelous at the Live ★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Show more and more marvelous just like that!
Just like Mama☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Respect, and admiration for one's mother...
I relate to that sentiment deeply.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's keep going!
I'll stay with you till the very end!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oka~y☆★☆
I want to try the freestyle part next!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "I wanna add a touch of my own style, but what do you think would be good, Trainer? ☆"
choice_data_list: How about focusing on your footwork!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A charming performance like this will surely
bring out her natural, effortless appeal."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, that might work!
It'll be Marvelous made just for me☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: For example... something like this♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hup!
How's that?☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Not bad.
However, if you wish to reach the entire audience during the live show,
you should also make use of the runway and sub-stages—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, she worked hard on her dance lessons, aiming to master her mother's dance while adding her own unique touches.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You're petite, but that makes you nimble.
Moving around with lighter, bouncier steps
might make you stand out more."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, this could work, this could really work!
This is going to be a super marvelous dance☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Umm~, like this?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, more, more!☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, she worked hard on her dance lessons, aiming to master her mother's dance while adding her own unique touches.
